# The flex-direction Property

#### Course: Learn CSS

## The flex-direction Property

By default, items in a flexbox are arranged horizontally in a row, i.e., flex-direction: row.

```html
1<div class="container">
2    <div class="box box1">First Item</div>
3    <div class="box box2">Second Item</div>
4    <div class="box box3">Third Item</div>
5</div>
```

```css
1.container {
2    display: flex;
3    gap: 10px;
4}
```

Browser Output

![Flex Row](data:image/png;base64,)

As you can see, we get the same result as the previous program because flex-direction: row is the default value which doesn't need to be specified.
